entries.name: Grid
entries.reason: Replace the coordinate-folding Tiler with a general Grid repeater: repeat sampled RGBA, use consistent cell-local coordinates, support row-controlled per-cell transforms, and define gap/edge behavior.

entries.name: Compose Channels
entries.reason: Builds an RGBA value from four independent scalar controls or row connections.

entries.name: Levels
entries.reason: Remaps an explicit input range into an output range, with gamma and optional clamping.

entries.name: Curve
entries.reason: Shapes values through four fixed horizontal positions using straight segments or a monotone cubic.

entries.name: Distance Profile
entries.reason: Converts a signed distance into a reusable bevel, crown or height profile.

entries.name: Normal Combine
entries.reason: Combines base and detail tangent-space normal maps using reoriented normal mapping.

entries.name: Vector Math
entries.reason: Length, distance, dot product, normalization, projection and XY rotation of vectors.

entries.name: Color Ramp
entries.reason: Maps the selected first channel through four ordered RGBA color stops.

entries.name: Scatter
entries.reason: Seeded overlapping RGBA stamps with multiple instances per cell, size/intensity variation, layers and Over/Add/Maximum blending.

entries.name: Coordinates
entries.reason: Cartesian, polar and cylindrical coordinate data, with 3D scaling, Euler rotation and translation. Connect XY or XYZ to a row's coordinate input. Angles use turns.

entries.name: Partition
entries.reason: Repeats RGBA in irregular intervals with shared boundaries, stable instance keys and normalized local coordinates.

entries.name: Height Gradient
entries.reason: General-purpose height derivative and vector-steered neighborhood filtering for surface construction.

entries.name: Vector Filter
entries.reason: General-purpose height derivative and vector-steered neighborhood filtering for surface construction.

additions.name: Compose Channels
additions.purpose: Build a vector/RGBA result from independent scalar rows; channel selection alone only extracts components from one row.

additions.name: Levels / Range Remap
additions.purpose: Explicit input/output ranges, clamping and midpoint control, rather than only the current assumed-range connection remap.

additions.name: Scalar Curve / Distance Profile
additions.purpose: Reusable bevel, crown and wear shaping from scalar or distance data, without material-specific sources.

additions.name: Vector Math / Projection
additions.purpose: Expose length, distance and dot/projection operations for row data; preserve the distinction between rotating values and resampling a domain.

additions.name: Normal Combine
additions.purpose: Combine coarse and fine encoded tangent-space normals using an explicit convention.

additions.name: Scatter
additions.purpose: Deterministic instance placement with stable IDs, local coordinates and bounded neighbor evaluation.
additions.implementation: Dedicated bounded Scatter with multiple stamps, size/intensity variation, layers, Over/Add/Maximum and winning fields.

additions.name: Image-pass operations
additions.purpose: Distance transform, flood fill, morphology, broad blur, slope blur and height-derived AO/curvature need a cached multipass execution plan beneath the existing rows.

grid_acceptance: Repeat arbitrary upstream RGBA, including Circle/Rounded Rectangle coverage, rather than RGB only.
Cell Data and Grid agree on count, origin, offset, wrapping and IDs.
Separate group ID, brick/subcell ID and transformed local UV.
Allow per-cell 90-degree rotation driven by parity, without a Basketweave mode.
Define gaps, filtering and neighbor evaluation when instances are shifted or rotated.
Build the two-brick basketweave as rows and confirm independent per-brick variation.

grid_acceptance_status: implemented; exercised by numerical, nested RGBA, instance/group identity and Metal agreement tests plus basketweave and running-bond examples

engine_foundation.scope_tracking: Per-component pixel/instance/footprint dependencies; metric distance preserved for instance-uniform geometry.
engine_foundation.execution_planning: Expensive directional filters and periodic wrappers partition into intermediate GPU images with halo padding, affine/wrapped domains, mip filtering, bounded memory and dependency cache keys.
engine_foundation.named_fields: Stable field.swizzle references, visible on existing wire menus, resolved to shared specialized IR evaluations.
engine_foundation.coordinates: Affine 3D transforms, polar/cylindrical conversion, XY/XYZ row bindings and estimated footprints.
engine_foundation.partitions: Irregular 1D intervals and per-ring sector counts, both retaining stable instance keys.
engine_foundation.placement_frames: Composed origin and axes support instance center, size and orientation fields through nested placement and affine transforms.
engine_foundation.remaining_limits: Iterative image operators need kernels and resource lifetime scheduling; cached calls through unsupported dynamic or instance-dependent domains return diagnostics.
engine_foundation.height_filters: Height Gradient and Vector Filter operate on bounded cached image inputs. Height to Normal now declares the same execution contract.
engine_foundation.parameter_sharing: Repeated parameter connections to the same resolved source share one sample per node on CPU and Metal, with matching budgets. Input/coordinate contexts remain separate.
engine_foundation.rock_recipe: Fractured Rock uses modern Polygon, tilted planes, layered material channels, Scatter, vector filtering and curvature wear; no specialized rock-pattern source. Arbitrary-mask distance transforms and iterative erosion remain pending.
